# ggsegCampbell

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/ggsegverse/ggsegCampbell/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ggsegverse/ggsegCampbell/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![r-universe](https://ggsegverse.r-universe.dev/badges/ggsegCampbell)](https://ggsegverse.r-universe.dev/ggsegCampbell)
<!-- badges: end -->

Campbell Atlas for the ggsegverse Ecosystem.

## Installation

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# From r-universe
install.packages("ggsegCampbell", repos = "https://ggsegverse.r-universe.dev")

# From GitHub
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("ggsegverse/ggsegCampbell")
```

## Atlases
### campbell
 
Campbell 1905 cortical parcellation.

```{r campbell}
library(ggsegCampbell)
plot(campbell())
```
## Data source

Annotation files from Pijnenburg et al. (2021) supplementary materials.

- **Reference**: Campbell (1905); Pijnenburg et al. (2021) [doi:10.1016/j.neuroimage.2021.118274](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuroimage.2021.118274)

- **Date obtained**: 2021-11-04
